description: LOWELL, Mass. (Oct. 10, 2019) – Today, Congresswoman Lori Trahan (D-MA-03) was endorsed by NARAL Pro-Choice America in her campaign for re-election to represent Massachusetts’ 3rd Congressional District. “I am honored to receive the endorsement of NARAL Pro-Choice America for my re-election campaign,” said Congresswoman Trahan. “At a time when women’s reproductive rights are under […]

title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
